tips.alliance: Allies can't attack each other and can send each other troops and gold. A strong neighbour is often more useful as an ally than as an enemy.
tips.attack_ratio: Attack with more troops than the defender has and you lose fewer of your own. The advantage stops growing past 2 to 1.
tips.boat: Boats carry troops across water. Use them to land on a coast you can't reach by land.
tips.city: Cities raise your maximum population. Build one when you run out of land to take.
tips.coast: Spawning next to the sea pays off later: coasts let you build ports and send boats.
tips.defense: Defense posts slow down attacks on nearby borders and make the attacker lose more troops.
tips.emp: An EMP destroys nothing, but switches off enemy defense posts, SAMs, silos, ports and radars for 15 seconds. Strike right before you attack.
tips.factory: Factories link your cities and ports by rail. Trains earn gold for every building they visit, and more at your neighbours'.
tips.frames: The frame around a building shows its level: bronze at 2, silver at 3, gold from 4.
tips.mirv: A MIRV splits into a swarm of warheads over a huge area, and only hits the player you aimed at.
tips.objectives: Map objectives appear one minute into the game. Each one you hold gives +15% gold and +5% troops: own most of its zone for 15 seconds to capture it.
tips.peace: Losing a war? Offer peace to the player you're fighting: three minutes without attacks, with no alliance needed. Anyone who breaks it is marked as a traitor in front of all players.
tips.radar: A radar spots enemy boats, warships and missiles within 100 tiles, so you see an invasion coming.
tips.sam: SAM launchers shoot down missiles in range. Each SAM level adds a missile ready to fire and more range.
tips.steam_ranked: Ranked, Versus and public lobbies are played in the Territorium app on Steam.
tips.steam_workshop: On Steam, publish your maps to the Workshop and play the community's.
tips.trade: Ports trade with other countries on their own, and both sides earn gold. Attacking a player stops your trade with them for 5 minutes.
tips.traitor: Breaking an alliance makes you a traitor for 30 seconds: your defense drops by half and other players trust you less.
tips.upgrade: Click one of your buildings to upgrade it: a bigger city holds more people, a bigger port sends more ships and a bigger factory sends more trains. Every building has a maximum level.

help_modal.ally_betray: Break the alliance - you become a traitor for 30 seconds: an icon above your name and half your defense. Trade with them stops for 5 minutes and others may trust you less.
help_modal.basics_economy: Turn your gold into cities for more troops, factories and ports for more gold, and defenses where your borders are exposed.
help_modal.basics_expand: Grow into the empty land around you, then take tribes and weaker neighbors. Each attack sends part of your troops, so let them regrow in between.
help_modal.basics_spawn: Pick your starting spot on the map. A coastline gives you boats, ports and sea trade later on.
help_modal.basics_win: Hold 80% of the land to win the game. In long games that target slowly drops.
help_modal.build_atom_desc: A small bomb that wipes out land, buildings and ships where it lands. Launched from your nearest silo.
help_modal.build_city_desc: Raises your maximum troops. The best way to grow when you run out of land to take.
help_modal.build_defense_desc: Strengthens the border around it, shown with a checkered pattern. Attacks there are slower and cost the enemy many more troops.
help_modal.build_emp_desc: Deals no damage: switches off enemy defense posts, SAMs, silos, ports and radars within 20 tiles for 15 seconds. Allies are spared, and SAMs can shoot it down.
help_modal.build_factory_desc: Lays railways to your nearby cities, ports and factories, and to your allies'. Trains run along them and earn gold at each stop, more at a neighbor's.
help_modal.build_hydrogen_desc: A much bigger bomb, for when a whole region has to go. Launched from your nearest silo.
help_modal.build_intro: Everything you can build, from the build bar or the wrench of the radial menu. Most prices rise with each one you own.
help_modal.build_mirv_desc: The biggest weapon in the game: splits into many warheads over a huge area of the player you aimed at, and only them.
help_modal.build_port_desc: Coast only. Sends trade ships to other countries' ports, earning gold for both sides, and builds warships. Trade stops for 5 minutes with anyone you fight.
help_modal.build_radar_desc: Spots enemy boats, warships and missiles within 100 tiles. Each radar you own makes the next one cost more.
help_modal.build_sam_desc: Shoots down enemy missiles within 70 tiles (up to about 100 once upgraded). It reloads for 9 seconds after each shot.
help_modal.build_silo_desc: Launches your atom bombs, hydrogen bombs, EMPs and MIRVs. After each launch it reloads for 9 seconds.
help_modal.build_warship_desc: Patrols the waters where you place it, capturing trade ships and sinking enemy boats and warships. Leaves from your nearest port. Gets stronger (up to level 3) with each catch. Attack-click it, then attack-click water, to move it.
help_modal.exit_confirmation: Are you sure you want to exit the game?
help_modal.icon_ally: Handshake - Ally. This player is your ally.
help_modal.icon_crown: Crown - Number 1. This is the top player in the leaderboard.
help_modal.icon_embargo: Dollar stop sign - Embargo. This player has stopped trading with you automatically or manually.
help_modal.icon_request: Envelope - Alliance request. This player has sent you an alliance request.
help_modal.icon_traitor: Broken shield - Traitor. This player attacked an ally.
help_modal.in_game_tutorial_desc: Learn by playing: a solo game against three easy nations where a guide walks you through your first conquests, your first buildings, map objectives and your first missile, then asks you to defeat the nations.
help_modal.info_alliance: Handshake - ask for an alliance. Allies can't attack each other and can send each other troops and gold.
help_modal.info_chat: Quick chat - pick a category and a phrase; if it names a player, pick who, then send.
help_modal.info_emoji: Emoji - send a quick emoji to the player.
help_modal.info_peace: White flag - offer a peace treaty to a player you are at war with (fighting now, or in the last 2 minutes). Once signed, neither of you can attack the other for 3 minutes and attacks in progress stop. Whoever breaks it is marked as a traitor and every player is told.
help_modal.info_surrender: Surrender (Nations mode) - once you have lost three quarters of your country, offer to become the vassal of a player you are at war with. If they accept, neither of you can attack the other for 10 minutes and you pay them 25% of your gold income.
help_modal.info_target: Target - mark this player for all your allies, to plan an attack together.
help_modal.info_trade: Trade - stop or restart sending trade ships to this player. Trade starts again when you both allow it.
help_modal.objectives_bonus: Each objective you hold gives +15% gold and +5% troops.
help_modal.objectives_cap: Only up to half of the objectives count toward your bonus (2 of 4, 3 of 5 or 6), so no one wins just by holding them all.
help_modal.objectives_capture: Own most of the zone for 15 seconds to capture it. The ring fills up while you hold it.
help_modal.objectives_desc: Some games place objectives on the map. They appear one minute into the game, with an announcement, so no one can rush them from the start. Each one is a zone worth holding for the whole game.
help_modal.objectives_where: They appear in solo, private and public games; ranked, 1v1, 2v2 and the daily race have none. The game's creator can turn them off.
help_modal.panel_desc: Shows a country's troops, gold, buildings and relations with you, with these actions:
help_modal.radial_attack: Sword (center) - attack with your attack ratio's worth of troops. The red sword opens missiles and warships aimed at that spot.
help_modal.radial_boat: Boat - land troops on that spot by sea. Only when you have a coastline.
help_modal.radial_build: Wrench - build here: pick a building and it goes where you clicked.
help_modal.radial_delete: Red cross - demolish your building closest to where you clicked.
help_modal.radial_donate_gold: Send gold - pick an amount of gold to give your ally.
help_modal.radial_donate_troops: Send troops - give your ally as many troops as your attack ratio.
help_modal.radial_info: Info - open the player panel for this country.
help_modal.radial_intro: Right-click anywhere on the map (tap on a phone) to open the radial menu. What it offers depends on whose land you clicked.
help_modal.troubleshooting_desc: If you experience performance issues, crashes, or other problems while playing Territorium, please visit our Troubleshooting page for help diagnosing and fixing common issues:
help_modal.ui_attack_ratio: Attack ratio - the share of your troops sent with each attack. Sending more troops than the defender has means fewer losses; the effect stops at 2 to 1.
help_modal.ui_build_bar: Build bar - every building and weapon, with its hotkey and how many you own. Greyed-out items are locked or too expensive; hover one to see its price.
help_modal.ui_control_intro: The panel at the bottom of the screen holds everything you use in a fight.
help_modal.ui_events_text: The event feed lists attacks on you and by you, alliance requests, chat messages and the big moments of the game. Click an attack to jump to it, and answer alliance requests right from the feed.
help_modal.ui_gold: Gold - how much gold you have to spend.
help_modal.ui_leaderboard_text: The leading players with their share of the land, gold and troops. Click a name to jump to that player.
help_modal.ui_objectives: Objectives - how many map objectives you hold and the bonus they give you. Only shown when the map has objectives.
help_modal.ui_options_text: Game clock, speed, pause, settings, full screen and exit. Speed and pause only work in solo games.
help_modal.ui_playeroverlay_text: Hover a country to see its name, gold, troops and how many of each building it owns. Hover your own land for the same view of yourself.
help_modal.ui_troops: Troops - how many you have against your maximum, and how fast they grow (on the left). Growth slows as you get close to the maximum; cities raise it.
help_modal.upgrades_desc: Click one of your buildings to open its card: its level, what the next level brings and the upgrade button.
help_modal.upgrades_economy: Cities, ports and factories go up to level 5, right away. Each level of a city holds more people, a port sends more trade ships and repairs more warships at once, a factory sends more trains.
help_modal.upgrades_frames: Upgraded buildings get a frame on the map: bronze at level 2, silver at 3, gold at 4 and emerald at 5.
help_modal.upgrades_military: SAMs go up to level 5 (+1 missile ready and more range per level), silos and radars up to level 3. Each new level unlocks as the game goes on: the card shows the countdown.
help_modal.upgrades_ranked: In ranked games levels are lower (SAM 3, silo and radar 2) and unlock later.

tutorial.complete: You're ready. The map is yours to take!

step.alliance_info: Allies can't attack each other. You can break an alliance at any time, but you'll be branded a traitor.
step.atom_info: Atom bomb: a small strike that wipes out land and buildings.
step.attack_nations: Nations block your way to the tribes. Attack a neighboring nation instead: they fight back harder, so send plenty of troops. The nearest ones have a target on them. Keep going until you have {cost} gold for a city.
step.attack_ratio: This slider sets how many of your troops leave with each attack. Drag it to try.
step.attack_wilderness: The pulsing ring is your land. Click the empty land next to it to claim it.
step.buy_city: You can afford a city! Press {key} (or click the city in the build bar), then click your land to place it. Cities raise your maximum troops.
step.buy_defense_post: Protect a border with a defense post: press {key}, then click your land near a border. Attacks around it are much slower and cost the enemy far more troops.
step.buy_factory: Time for a factory: press {key}, then click your land to place it.
step.buy_port: Now a port: press {key}, then click your coastline to place it.
step.buy_silo: Last building: a missile silo. Press {key}, then click your land to place it. Silos launch every missile in the game.
step.buy_warship: Take the sea with a warship: press {key}, then click open water near your port. Warships capture trade ships and guard your waters.
step.capture_tribes: Tribes are easy prey and full of gold. The nearest ones have a target on them: take them until you have {cost} gold for a city.
step.defeat_nations: Last objective: defeat the nations to finish your training. Each one still standing has a target on it (nations remaining: {left}). You can't attack an ally: wait for the alliance to end, or break it and be branded a traitor.
step.earn_gold: Take land from your neighbors and conquer them to seize their gold. You need {cost} for a {unit}.
step.emp_info: EMP: no damage, but it switches off enemy defenses, silos, ports and radars for 15 seconds. Perfect before an attack.
step.factory_info: Your factory lays railways to your cities and factories. Trains run along them and bring in gold at every stop.
step.hydrogen_info: Hydrogen bomb: a far bigger blast to cripple a whole region.
step.launch_atom: Your silo is ready! Press {key}, then click a neighbor's land to launch an atom bomb.
step.mirv_info: MIRV: a rain of warheads over a single enemy. The ultimate weapon.
step.no_coast: You have no coastline yet. The sea opens up boats, ports and trade: expand until you reach the coast.
step.objectives: This map has objectives: glowing zones that appear one minute into the game. Own most of one for 15 seconds to capture it, for +15% gold and +5% troops. This counter shows the time left before they appear, then how many you hold.
step.port_info_ships: Ports send trade ships to other countries, and every trip earns you gold.
step.propose_alliance: A strong neighbor is better as a friend. Right-click the nation with the target and ask for an alliance.
step.radar_info: Radar: spots enemy boats, warships and missiles around it, even far from your borders.
step.sam_info: SAM launcher: shoots down enemy missiles coming at your land.
step.send_boat: Boats carry your troops across the water. Right-click an enemy coast across the sea to open the radial menu, then pick the boat.
step.silo_loading: Your silo is loading. You can launch as soon as it's ready.
step.spawn: Welcome to Territorium! Click anywhere on the map to pick your starting spot. A coastline will come in handy later.
step.spawn_wait: Spot picked! You can still move it until the timer runs out, then the game begins.
step.traitor_info: A traitor loses half of their defense for 30 seconds. Choose your moment carefully.
step.troop_rate: This is how fast your troops grow. It slows down, and turns orange, once you pass half of your maximum.
step.troops: These are your troops. Every attack spends some of them, so give them time to regrow between attacks.
step.upgrade_city: Buildings can be upgraded. Click your city to open its card, then press Upgrade: each level makes room for more people, up to level 5.

webgl_gate.intro_limited: A privacy setting caps the graphics below what the game needs, so parts of the map may show black. Exempt this site from it:
webgl_gate.intro_software: Your browser isn't using your graphics card, so the game can't run smoothly. Turn hardware acceleration on, then restart your browser:
webgl_gate.intro_unsupported: Your browser doesn't support WebGL2, which the game needs. Turn it on, or update your browser:
webgl_gate.note_drivers: Still stuck? Update your graphics card drivers, or try another browser.
webgl_gate.note_limited: The protection stays on for every other site.
webgl_gate.step_chrome: Settings › System › turn on graphics acceleration, then relaunch Chrome.
webgl_gate.step_edge: Settings › System and performance › turn on hardware acceleration, then restart Edge.
webgl_gate.step_firefox: Type about:config in the address bar, set webgl.disabled to false and webgl.force-enabled to true, then restart Firefox.
webgl_gate.step_limited: Type about:config in the address bar, find privacy.resistFingerprinting.exemptedDomains, add {host} (separated by a comma), then restart the browser.
webgl_gate.step_safari: Settings › Websites › WebGL › choose Allow. On iPhone and iPad it is always on.
webgl_gate.title_limited: Your browser is limiting the graphics
webgl_gate.title_unsupported: Your browser can't run the game
